scope: Optional Script screenshot metadata in existing GUI activity, stopped/live MCP responses and the Ouroboros diagnostics disclosure; private GUI bridge descriptor publication in long temporary directories.
accepted: Private GUI bridge files resolve the existing parent to an extended Windows path for create, publication and cleanup, retaining the protected current-logon ACL, CREATE_NEW semantics and atomic publication.
Existing version-1 callback observations retain compatibility when optional capture metadata is absent or malformed.
Request and receipt generations, counts, monotonic ages, pending interval, dimensions and worker acceptance are metadata only; no image content, path, hash or credential is exposed.
The independent observer performs bounded atomic reads and one nonblocking worker try_lock, without file I/O, image copying or a GUI request round trip.
PNG worker status is sampled independently from request/receipt markers; the combined response is not a globally atomic pipeline transaction.
Ouroboros and existing MCP surfaces distinguish request, receipt, worker acceptance and publication; retirement does not imply completion.
limits: Native acceptance used one stopped x64 GUI, one setup MCP client and two virtual pairs, with no Start, routing, targets or backend DLLs.
Blocked-writer, lock contention, malformed/legacy metadata, wrong-ticket and retirement cases use deterministic Rust coverage; no native failure injection or broad reliability matrix was run.
Ages do not time glReadPixels, normal repaint, presentation or input delivery. This does not identify a historical stall cause or establish a GUI-stall fix.
Historical GUI-stall P1, full Ultra/UI parity, hardware and broad application coverage, and release readiness remain open.
